guarantees_metadata.page_title: Trust Guarantees & Payment Structure | Thomas Cherickal
guarantees_metadata.description: Risk-free and scam-free training structure: zero money upfront, five equal installments, walkaway guarantee, and Apache 2.0 commercial license.
guarantees_metadata.hero_desc: How our zero-upfront, five-installment plan and Apache 2.0 commercial license keep you safe, give you total control, and make every project risk-free.

trust_pillars.title: Strictly Zero Dollars Upfront ($0)
trust_pillars.description: You never pay a single cent before training begins. There are no registration fees, no setup fees, and no advance deposits.

trust_pillars.title: Pay Training in Five Equal Parts (20% Each)
trust_pillars.description: Your live training investment is divided into five equal payments of 20% each. You only pay after each training milestone is completed and verified by you.

trust_pillars.title: Zero Charge Dedicated Support Period
trust_pillars.description: Dedicated support requires zero extra payment. For Flagships (Business and Personal), 30 days of dedicated support is fully covered by the $3,000 USD price and its scaled parity tiers. For individual services, 5 days of support is fully covered by the $300 USD price and its scaled parity tiers.

trust_pillars.title: Walk Away Free Guarantee
trust_pillars.description: Try the training with zero financial risk. If you are not completely happy after the first phase, you can walk away owing nothing.

trust_pillars.title: Clear Daily Schedule
trust_pillars.description: Training takes place for 4 hours each day, Monday through Friday. Saturdays and Sundays are restful holidays. Every session is delivered 100% online so anyone worldwide can join.

trust_pillars.title: Full Commercial Ownership (Apache 2.0)
trust_pillars.description: Everything created during the training - all written notes, guides, checklists, and code - belongs to you under the open Apache 2.0 license. You can use it inside your business, sell it to clients, or share it however you want.

apache_license_rights.description: Use all lesson materials, scripts, and prompts in your daily business operations without paying any royalties.
Package, share, or resell the guides, courses, and tools directly to your own clients or customers.
Share all notes and videos freely across your whole company so future team members can learn too.
Build your own products or services on top of what you learned. All that is needed is a simple credit line mentioning the author.
